reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests the car pulling forward, a new temporal motion that overrides the reference’s static pose.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the live-action reference medium because no rendering-medium change was requested.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested; the car’s observed carbon-fibre body is retained from the reference.
reasons.lighting: “Out of the dark” specifies the lighting condition and visible quality of the car emerging from darkness, so lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement is requested; moving forward is not itself a framing instruction, so framing follows the reference.
reasons.palette: No scene color palette is requested; darkness concerns lighting rather than palette, so palette follows the reference.
